name: Instable Instable
description: Manifestation d'une réalité parallèle, Instable Instable émerge d'une réalité parallèle, maîtrise la Faille Dimensionnelle, anomalie épique de la faille, arme une arme imprévisible. Son existence même crée des distorsions spatio-temporelles, rendant les attaques ennemies imprévisibles et disjointes.

subject.archetype: Dissonant Entropist Combat Specialist - Humanoid cultist entity, gaunt skeletal frame with exposed scarified flesh, limbs bent at impossible angles, skin displaying rapid aging decay patterns (cracking, peeling, rotting in accelerated succession), body partially phased through multiple dimensional layers simultaneously causing silhouette duplication and visual tearing at edges

loadout.armor_outfit: Tattered military armor remnants fused directly to corrupted flesh through dimensional bleeding, plates of twisted metal warped like melted wax floating in anti-gravitational suspension around torso, shredded uniform fabrics billowing in zero-gravity pockets with fragments existing in different temporal states (pristine, worn, disintegrating simultaneously), exposed ribs displaying pulsing violet-black organic circuitry beneath split skin
loadout.arsenal: Right arm terminates in a concentrated energy projection manifesting as a thick flowing ribbon of intense radioactive green chronon particles streaming from open palm, the energy forming visible connection threads to ally target, left arm holds a warped obsidian-longword fused at molecular level with glitching purple crystal formations, weapon edges showing simultaneous states of sharp/fragmented/dissolving, ambient objects around the specialist floating and rotating chaotically while being rapidly aged and decayed

attitude.behavior: Full combat commitment with body momentum, torso twisted in aggressive forward thrust, one arm powerfully extended toward allied target with perfect alignment for energy transfer, opposite arm gripping weapon with desperate strength, posture representing absolute combat focus while channeling entropic powers, legs planted against malfunctioning gravity with debris falling in impossible directions around stance
attitude.emotion: Eyes fully rolled back revealing bloodshot whites, mouth contorted in expression oscillating between agonized scream and ecstatic revelation, entire body emanating waves of reality distortion causing visible chromatic aberration and scan-line artifacts around silhouette, psychological state indicating complete immersion in dimensional collapse while maintaining tactical awareness of ally positioning

special_effects: Reality fragmentation overlay with multiple exposure blending
Chromatic aberration intensifying toward entity center
Temporal decay particle system aging all environmental elements
Dimensional phase bleeding showing parallel version overlays
Scan-line artifacts and digital corruption artifacts across entire composition

scenography.setting: Reality_collapse_zone_exactly_as_specified: environment fragmenting into simultaneous parallel versions with buildings existing in two-dimensional superposition states showing both intact architectural structures and their destroyed rubble overlays occupying identical space, fractured ground revealing layered parallel battlefields beneath with opposing forces frozen in combat stacked like corrupted stereoscopic images, debris objects falling in contradictory directions (upward, sideways, inverted) within different gravity pockets, sky dome containing mutually exclusive celestial bodies (normal starfield overlapping with void blackness, multiple suns of different colors, planetary bodies intersecting incorrectly)
